introHtml: Imprintid neck gaiters and buffs offer a seamless way to add your logo to a versatile accessory that works for outdoor events, trade shows, and employee uniforms. Made from moisture-wicking fabric, these tubular bandanas provide sun protection and can be worn multiple ways. Choose from styles like the Bandana or Winterdana for year-round branding. Screen printing or full-color sublimation ensures your design stands out on every piece.
